text: Commander, the Pact crossed the border at oh-four-hundred. Our covering force holds the Fulda corridor. Trade space for time, keep the cavalry alive, and hold the crossroads until the brigade is up.
speaker: Ryan
instruction: Calm, clipped US Army staff officer briefing a commander over a field radio; steady, serious, unhurried.
